marketing_description: The NUVO® by SATCO 62‑1778 fixture delivers 2200 lumens from a single 75‑W LED bulb with a 3000‑K color temperature and CRI 90+. Designed for contractor select applications, it operates at 120/277 V, 0.242/0.105 A, 60 Hz, and is dimmable with a frosted PMMA lens on an aluminum body finished in white. The 19‑inch round fixture, IP44 rated, includes the bulb and measures 5 in H × 7‑1/2 in W × 1‑1/2 in D.
